title: Conditional κ = 0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769983114385025802954603275201628645482603256388263056561328: recertified 1e-10000 supplier endpoint and 1e-10010 slacks (kappa +2.00336e-500 over PR1897): fine source-prime padding (PR1786) at the free epsilon -> 1 point, with gauge-free interiors and the radix-distributed union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769…(10046 digits)**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-10010 or below, with fine source-prime padding (PR1786, chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa, via Tim Trudgian's prime theorem; vendored) which makes the grouped chirp guard beta + 2 xi - 2 < 1, the fractional-shift gauge-free interiors with accretive shallow circuits (PR1758, outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md), the radix-distributed union schedule with per-visit tag work, and the explicit Strassen boundary. New here: epsilon is a free parameter of the PR1786 ledger (every row holds for every 1-epsilon > 1e-10010), so the explicit point is epsilon = 1 - 2e-10010, beta = 1 - 6e-10010, giving kappa = 0.00167975495612554452133567099392070257..., 3.4e-10013 below the supplier's complex saving q, hence the ceiling of any outer of this form (outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md). 62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls, an independent balance derivation with an epsilon sweep, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and the gauge-free identity checks are regenerated; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses and the cited prime theorem; the fine-padding lemmas (PR1786 is a draft) and the composition need independent review; asymptotic margins are 2e-10010. Endpoint recertification: native and conservative complex endpoints refined to 1e-10000 (accept at endpoint, reject at endpoint + 1e-10000) with the repaired fine engines evaluated in directed-rounding integer fixed point; kappa exceeds PR1897 by 2.00336e-500, PR1876 by 8.11857e-401, PR1875 by 6.06686e-301 and PR1839 by 6.56133e-91 (62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls).

## Verification

Fresh checkout of follow-up head `07e4e4231459e36b1055396306dcbd950248df62` (follow-up to the original head `efb276be7206b824c23c7042046be54acc1cac4b`). Manifest: `7a15370f528a86703b9ffb0391c160e5b3a0eccde0e48b06fb61cad3376ae1de`.
PASS package manifest: 383 files

`PASS_RELEASE` in 539.88 seconds (full `verify_release.py` on a fresh copy of the committed package, native cache reused; the receipt binds this manifest and the unchanged kappa).

Follow-up changes (kappa byte-identical to the original head; chain exponents, `CLAIM.json`, `new/SPEC.json` unchanged):
* **Carried bootstrap cutoffs (repair of #1956, Josie Elliston).** The earlier cutoff formula omitted the constant carried from the previous stage. Stage j now uses the least power of two L_j with L_j*gap_j^2 >= 36 and L_j*gap_j >= 2(4+ell_j), where ell_0 = 512 and ell_{j+1} = max(512, ell_j + ceil(L_j*(a_{j+1}-a_j))) + 1, both asserted exactly in integers at proof time; a control asserts that the old uncarried cutoffs fail the carry rule at stages 2-7.
* **Lemma G label/adapter stage (#1964, thakrarsagar; Lemma G by DreamingOfClouds, #509/#516).** New `lemmag-labels` stage beside the frame-only local replay: `label_check` (strict and permissive) and `adapter_rule` report 0 violations on each provider's LOCAL-PROGRAMS in both orientations, and the X (exit straddle), Y (entry straddle) and Z (exit adapters moved before a phase-B add) adapter mutants are REJECTED.

Supplier: the package's own `verify.py` (retained PR1297 provider and parent admission, owner reconstruction, parent lift, strict T74 admission, geometry controls, now with the `lemmag-labels` stage) passed inside the release run.

## Credits

PR1786 (chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa): fine source-prime padding, its proof and checks, vendored under vendor/pr1786; Tim Trudgian: effective prime number theorem (arXiv:1401.2689). PR1673 (Vlado Vojdanovski, with AI assistance): capped phase-cell fusion outer construction, its proof and exact evidence, vendored under vendor/pr1673. PR1758 (IdeaOuter and contributors): fractional-shift gauge-free interiors, accretive shallow-circuit lemma, per-visit tag accounting. Jeremy Kothe and contributors (PR1731 ledger lineage, radix-union schedule), LeverRank (independent schedule simulation), Gohberg, Semencul, Kailath, Kung, Morf, Bitmead, Anderson, Pan (structured Toeplitz-like algorithms of the retained alternative), Francois Le Gall et al. and Chafik Boukhalfa (PR1699). Supplier: PR1625 (mdumitrean), PR1661 (midhatn), pivot-554 kernel (PR1672 lineage) and the PR1319/PR1297/PR1274/PR1286 lineage as in earlier packages. PR1897 (M6LI), PR1876, PR1875 and PR1828 (rohanarun): the endpoint and slack refinements that this package exceeds; rohanarun also PR1319 and PR1297; chafreaky PR1786; Vlado Vojdanovski PR1673; mdumitrean PR1625; midhatn; philippeVV PR1519 (odd-term Mercator finding); Kothe and the existing lineage.
